bleed.example_en: His knee began to bleed after he fell on the playground.
bleed.example_zh: 他在操场上摔倒后，膝盖开始流血。

blend.example_en: Blend the milk and eggs in a large bowl.
blend.example_zh: 把牛奶和鸡蛋放在大碗里搅拌均匀。

bless.example_en: Grandma will bless the family meal before anyone eats.
bless.example_zh: 大家吃饭前，奶奶会为这顿饭祝福。

blow.example_en: Strong winds blow the leaves across our front yard.
blow.example_zh: 大风把落叶吹过我们家的前院。

boast.example_en: He likes to boast about his score in the maths test.
boast.example_zh: 他喜欢夸耀自己数学测验的分数。

boil.example_en: Boil the eggs for eight minutes before breakfast.
boil.example_zh: 早饭前把鸡蛋煮八分钟。

bore.example_en: Long speeches bore the students waiting in the hall.
bore.example_zh: 冗长的发言让在礼堂里等候的学生感到厌烦。

borrow.example_en: May I borrow your ruler for this drawing exercise?
borrow.example_zh: 这道绘画练习我可以借你的尺子吗？

bother.example_en: Don't bother Dad while he is cooking dinner.
bother.example_zh: 爸爸做晚饭的时候别打扰他。

bounce.example_en: The basketball will bounce off the gym wall.
bounce.example_zh: 篮球会从体育馆的墙上反弹回来。

break.example_en: Don't break the glass when you wash the dishes.
break.example_zh: 洗碗时别把玻璃杯打破。

breed.example_en: Farmers breed sheep on the green hills near town.
breed.example_zh: 农民在城镇附近的青山上饲养绵羊。

bring.example_en: Please bring your lunch to the picnic by the lake.
bring.example_zh: 去湖边野餐时，请带上你的午餐。

build.example_en: We will build a small bookshelf for my bedroom.
build.example_zh: 我们要为我的卧室做一个小书架。

burn.example_en: Too much sun can burn your skin at the beach.
burn.example_zh: 在海滩上，阳光太强会晒伤你的皮肤。

bury.example_en: The dog tried to bury its bone in the garden.
bury.example_zh: 那只狗想把骨头埋进花园里。

buy.example_en: Mum will buy fresh fruit at the market after work.
buy.example_zh: 妈妈下班后会去市场买新鲜水果。

calculate.example_en: Calculate the total cost before you pay the cashier.
calculate.example_zh: 付给收银员之前，先把总价算清楚。

call.example_en: I will call my grandma after I get home.
call.example_zh: 我到家以后会给奶奶打电话。

capture.example_en: The net can capture small fish in the pond.
capture.example_zh: 这张网能捕获池塘里的小鱼。

carry.example_en: Two students carry the heavy box up to the classroom.
carry.example_zh: 两个学生把这个重箱子搬到教室去。

catch.example_en: Try to catch the ball with both hands.

cause.example_en: Wet roads can cause accidents near our school.
cause.example_zh: 湿滑的路面可能在我们学校附近引发事故。

celebrate.example_en: We celebrate my sister's birthday with a big cake.
celebrate.example_zh: 我们用一个大蛋糕庆祝姐姐的生日。

chase.example_en: The puppy began to chase a ball across the field.
chase.example_zh: 小狗开始追着球跑过球场。

chat.example_en: My friends and I chat on the bus ride home.
chat.example_zh: 我和朋友们在回家的公交车上聊天。

check.example_en: Check your answers before you hand in the paper.
check.example_zh: 交卷之前先把答案检查一遍。

chew.example_en: Chew your food slowly during family dinner.
chew.example_zh: 家庭晚餐时要慢慢咀嚼食物。

choose.example_en: Choose a story you really want to read tonight.
choose.example_zh: 选一个你今晚真正想读的故事。

chuck.example_en: The boys chuck waste paper into the bin after art class.
chuck.example_zh: 美术课结束后，男孩们把废纸扔进垃圾桶。

claim.example_en: She can claim her lost bag at the school office.
claim.example_zh: 她可以到学校办公室认领丢失的书包。

climb.example_en: The children climb the hill behind our school.
climb.example_zh: 孩子们爬学校后面的那座小山。

combine.example_en: Art students combine red and blue to get purple.
combine.example_zh: 美术班的学生把红色和蓝色调成紫色。

come.example_en: Come to my house after the football game.
come.example_zh: 足球比赛结束后到我家来。

compare.example_en: Compare these two maps before choosing a route.
compare.example_zh: 选路线之前先比较这两张地图。

compile.example_en: The monitor will compile our scores into one chart.
compile.example_zh: 班长会把我们的分数汇总成一张表。

complete.example_en: Please complete this form before you leave the office.
complete.example_zh: 离开办公室前，请把这份表格填写完成。

comprise.example_en: The concert will comprise three short songs and a dance.
comprise.example_zh: 这场音乐会将包括三首短歌和一支舞蹈。

concentrate.example_en: Concentrate on the listening test and ignore the noise.
concentrate.example_zh: 做听力测试时要集中注意力，别管噪音。

concern.example_en: Exam results concern my parents more than sports scores.
concern.example_zh: 我父母更关注考试成绩，而不是体育分数。

conclude.example_en: These results let us conclude that the plant needs more sun.
conclude.example_zh: 这些结果让我们得出结论：这种植物需要更多阳光。

confuse.example_en: Similar spellings confuse me during the spelling quiz.
confuse.example_zh: 相近的拼写在拼写小测里让我感到困惑。

connect.example_en: Connect the printer to the computer with this cable.
connect.example_zh: 用这根线把打印机连到电脑上。

consider.example_en: Consider the weather before you leave for the picnic.
consider.example_zh: 出发去野餐前，先考虑一下天气。

consist.example_en: The dinner will consist of rice, soup, and fish.
consist.example_zh: 晚饭将由米饭、汤和鱼组成。

construct.example_en: They construct a model bridge during science class.
construct.example_zh: 他们在科学课上搭建一座桥的模型。

consult.example_en: We consult the coach before changing the match plan.
consult.example_zh: 更改比赛方案之前，我们会先和教练商量。

continue.example_en: Continue the story from the page where we stopped.
continue.example_zh: 从我们上次停下的那一页继续读这个故事。

convert.example_en: Convert these minutes into hours on the timetable.
convert.example_zh: 在时间表上把这些分钟换算成小时。

cook.example_en: Dad will cook noodles for the whole family tonight.
cook.example_zh: 爸爸今晚会给全家人煮面条。

cope.example_en: She can cope with a busy week of exams.
cope.example_zh: 她能应付这忙碌的考试周。

cough.example_en: Cover your mouth if you cough in the classroom.
cough.example_zh: 如果在教室里咳嗽，请捂住嘴巴。

count.example_en: Count the chairs before the guests sit down.
count.example_zh: 客人坐下之前，先数一数椅子。

cover.example_en: Cover the pot while the soup is still boiling.
cover.example_zh: 汤还在煮的时候，把锅盖上。

create.example_en: We create a short play for the school festival.
create.example_zh: 我们为学校的节日创作一个短剧。

cross.example_en: The two main streets cross near the city library.
cross.example_zh: 两条主要街道在市图书馆附近交叉。

cry.example_en: The baby may cry when the bedroom lights go out.
cry.example_zh: 卧室的灯灭了以后，宝宝可能会哭。

cut.example_en: Cut the apple into four pieces for the children.
cut.example_zh: 把苹果切成四块分给孩子们。

decide.example_en: Decide which club you want to join before Friday.
decide.example_zh: 星期五之前，先决定你想加入哪个社团。

declare.example_en: The referee will declare the winner after the race.
declare.example_zh: 裁判会在赛跑结束后宣布获胜者。

dedicate.example_en: She will dedicate this song to her mother.
dedicate.example_zh: 她要把这首歌献给妈妈。

defend.example_en: Thick coats defend us against the cold winter wind.
defend.example_zh: 厚外套能帮我们挡住冬天的寒风。

define.example_en: Can you define this science term in simple words?
define.example_zh: 你能用简单的话给这个科学术语下定义吗？

delay.example_en: Heavy rain may delay the school bus this afternoon.
delay.example_zh: 大雨可能会让校车今天下午晚点。

deny.example_en: He would not deny breaking the classroom window.
deny.example_zh: 他不会否认教室的窗户是他打破的。

depend.example_en: Our picnic plans depend on clear weather this weekend.
depend.example_zh: 我们的野餐安排取决于这个周末是否放晴。

derive.example_en: Many local cheeses derive from milk on nearby farms.
derive.example_zh: 许多本地奶酪都来自附近农场的牛奶。

describe.example_en: Describe your bedroom in five clear sentences.
describe.example_zh: 用五个清楚的句子描述一下你的卧室。

deserve.example_en: Hard-working players deserve a rest after the final.
deserve.example_zh: 勤奋的队员在决赛之后值得休息一下。

design.example_en: Our group will design a poster for sports day.
design.example_zh: 我们小组要为运动会设计一张海报。

destroy.example_en: A strong storm can destroy crops in the fields.
destroy.example_zh: 强风暴可能会毁掉田里的庄稼。

determine.example_en: The final race will determine this year's team winner.
determine.example_zh: 最后一场比赛将决定今年的团体冠军。

develop.example_en: Daily practice can develop your football skills.
develop.example_zh: 每天练习能够提升你的足球技术。

die.example_en: These plants die quickly without water in summer.
die.example_zh: 这些植物在夏天缺水会很快枯死。

dig.example_en: We dig small holes for trees behind the gym.
dig.example_zh: 我们在体育馆后面挖小坑种树。

disappear.example_en: The sun will disappear behind those hills at dusk.
disappear.example_zh: 黄昏时，太阳会消失在那些山后面。

discuss.example_en: Let's discuss the picnic menu during lunch break.
discuss.example_zh: 午休时，我们来讨论一下野餐的菜单吧。

distribute.example_en: Teachers distribute the test papers at nine o'clock.
distribute.example_zh: 老师们在九点分发试卷。

divide.example_en: Divide the cake into eight equal pieces.

do.example_en: I do my maths homework at the kitchen table.
do.example_zh: 我在厨房的桌子上做数学作业。

download.example_en: Download the city map before you leave home.
download.example_zh: 出门之前先把城市地图下载好。

draw.example_en: Draw a picture of your family for art class.
draw.example_zh: 美术课上画一张你的全家福。

drive.example_en: My uncle will drive us to the science museum.
drive.example_zh: 叔叔会开车送我们去科学博物馆。

drop.example_en: The plate will drop if you hold it with one hand.
drop.example_zh: 如果你只用一只手拿，盘子就会掉下去。

earn.example_en: She can earn pocket money by walking the neighbour's dog.
earn.example_zh: 她靠帮邻居遛狗来赚零花钱。

eat.example_en: We eat dumplings together on New Year's Eve.
eat.example_zh: 除夕晚上我们一起吃饺子。

edit.example_en: Edit your essay carefully before handing it in.
edit.example_zh: 交稿之前仔细修改你的文章。

educate.example_en: Good schools educate children from many different towns.
educate.example_zh: 好学校会教育来自许多不同城镇的孩子。

elect.example_en: Our class will elect a new monitor on Monday.
elect.example_zh: 我们班星期一将选出新班长。

emerge.example_en: The moon will emerge from behind the clouds tonight.
emerge.example_zh: 今晚月亮会从云层后面露出来。

emphasise.example_en: The coach will emphasise teamwork before the game.
emphasise.example_zh: 比赛开始前，教练会强调团队合作。

enable.example_en: This card will enable you to borrow library books.
enable.example_zh: 这张卡能让你借阅图书馆的书。

encourage.example_en: Parents encourage us to read before we sleep.
encourage.example_zh: 父母鼓励我们睡前读书。

engage.example_en: Our club members engage in team sports after lessons.
engage.example_zh: 课后，我们的社团成员会参加团队运动。

enhance.example_en: Songs and films enhance our spoken English after school.
enhance.example_zh: 放学后，歌曲和电影能提高我们的英语口语。

enjoy.example_en: We enjoy hot soup on cold winter evenings.
enjoy.example_zh: 寒冷的冬夜，我们喜欢喝热汤。

ensure.example_en: Ensure the front door is locked when you leave.
ensure.example_zh: 离开的时候，一定要确认前门已经锁好。

enter.example_en: Enter the museum through the wide main gate.
enter.example_zh: 从宽阔的正门进入博物馆。

entitle.example_en: A student ticket will entitle you to a cheaper seat.
entitle.example_zh: 持学生票可以买到更便宜的座位。

escape.example_en: The hamster tried to escape from its small cage.
escape.example_zh: 那只仓鼠试图从自己的小笼子里逃走。

establish.example_en: The school will establish a new reading club.
establish.example_zh: 学校将成立一个新的阅读社团。

examine.example_en: The doctor will examine your sore throat today.
examine.example_zh: 医生今天会检查你疼痛的喉咙。

exist.example_en: Wild pandas exist mainly in the mountains of Sichuan.
exist.example_zh: 野生大熊猫主要存在于四川的山区。

expect.example_en: I expect a letter from my uncle this week.
expect.example_zh: 我期待这周能收到叔叔的信。

explain.example_en: Can you explain this maths problem to me?
explain.example_zh: 你能把这道数学题解释给我听吗？

express.example_en: Short poems help students express feelings about home.
express.example_zh: 短诗能帮助学生表达对家的感情。

extend.example_en: The school may extend the holiday if snow continues.
extend.example_zh: 如果雪继续下，学校可能会延长假期。

face.example_en: Young athletes face strong rivals in the city final.
face.example_zh: 年轻选手要在全市决赛中面对强大的对手。

fail.example_en: You may fail the quiz if several answers stay blank.
fail.example_zh: 如果好几道题空着，你这次小测可能会不及格。

fall.example_en: Ripe apples fall from the old tree in autumn.
fall.example_zh: 秋天，熟了的苹果会从那棵老树上掉下来。

feed.example_en: I feed the goldfish before I leave for school.

feel.example_en: I feel cold when the classroom windows stay open.
feel.example_zh: 教室窗户开着的时候，我觉得冷。

fetch.example_en: Could you fetch a clean towel from the bathroom?
fetch.example_zh: 你能去浴室拿一条干净毛巾吗？

fight.example_en: Those two boys should not fight in the hallway.
fight.example_zh: 那两个男孩不该在走廊里打架。

fill.example_en: Fill your bottle with water before the long hike.
fill.example_zh: 长途步行之前，把你的水瓶灌满水。

find.example_en: I often find my keys in this coat pocket.
find.example_zh: 我经常在这件外套的口袋里找到钥匙。

finish.example_en: Finish your soup before it gets completely cold.
finish.example_zh: 趁汤还没彻底凉掉，把它喝完。

fit.example_en: These new shoes fit me after a week of walking.
fit.example_zh: 这双新鞋走了一个星期以后很合脚。

fix.example_en: Dad can fix the broken chair on Saturday morning.
fix.example_zh: 爸爸星期六早上能把那把坏椅子修好。

fly.example_en: Some birds fly across the sea when winter comes.
fly.example_zh: 冬天来的时候，有些鸟会飞过大海。

focus.example_en: Focus on your own paper during the maths exam.
focus.example_zh: 数学考试时要专心看自己的试卷。

follow.example_en: Follow the blue signs to the city library.
follow.example_zh: 沿着蓝色指示牌走到市图书馆。

forget.example_en: I sometimes forget my lunch box on the kitchen counter.
forget.example_zh: 我有时会把饭盒忘在厨房的台面上。

found.example_en: Local families will found a music club next term.
found.example_zh: 一些本地家庭下学期要创办一个音乐社团。

frighten.example_en: Loud thunder can frighten our dog at night.
frighten.example_zh: 夜里的响雷会把我们的狗吓到。

gain.example_en: You gain confidence when you speak in front of the class.
gain.example_zh: 当你在全班面前发言时，你会获得自信。

gather.example_en: We gather fallen leaves in the school garden.
gather.example_zh: 我们在学校花园里把落叶收集起来。

grant.example_en: The head teacher may grant us extra rehearsal time.
grant.example_zh: 校长可能会允许我们多一些排练时间。

grow.example_en: Tomatoes grow well in our sunny backyard.
grow.example_zh: 西红柿在我们家向阳的后院长得很好。

guess.example_en: Guess the price of that cake in the bakery window.
guess.example_zh: 猜一猜面包店橱窗里那块蛋糕的价钱。

handle.example_en: The monitor can handle problems while the teacher is out.
handle.example_zh: 老师不在时，班长能处理出现的问题。

hang.example_en: Hang your wet coat on the hook by the door.
hang.example_zh: 把湿外套挂在门边的钩子上。

happen.example_en: Accidents often happen when people run on wet stairs.
happen.example_zh: 人们在湿楼梯上奔跑时，常常会发生事故。

hate.example_en: I hate getting up early on cold winter mornings.
hate.example_zh: 我讨厌在寒冷的冬天早起。

hear.example_en: I can hear birds singing outside my bedroom window.
hear.example_zh: 我能听见鸟儿在我卧室的窗外唱歌。

help.example_en: Older classmates help younger ones with difficult homework.
help.example_zh: 高年级同学在较难的作业上帮助低年级同学。

hide.example_en: The kitten likes to hide behind the living room curtains.
hide.example_zh: 小猫喜欢躲在客厅的窗帘后面。

highlight.example_en: Highlight the key dates on your revision sheet.
highlight.example_zh: 在复习提纲上把重要的日期标出来。

hit.example_en: A fast ball can hit the window beside the gym.
hit.example_zh: 飞快的球可能会打到体育馆旁边的窗户。

hold.example_en: Hold the rope tightly while you cross the stream.
hold.example_zh: 过小溪的时候要紧紧抓住绳子。

hope.example_en: I hope the rain stops before our family picnic.
hope.example_zh: 我希望家庭野餐开始前雨能停。

host.example_en: Our school will host the city basketball final.
host.example_zh: 我们学校将主办全市篮球决赛。

hurry.example_en: Hurry to the school gate or you will miss the bus.
hurry.example_zh: 赶快跑到校门口，不然你会错过公交车。

hurt.example_en: Tight shoes can hurt your feet on a long walk.
hurt.example_zh: 鞋子太紧，走长路会把脚弄疼。

imagine.example_en: Imagine a quiet beach during the summer holiday.
imagine.example_zh: 想象一下暑假里那片安静的海滩。

implement.example_en: The school will implement new lunch rules next month.
implement.example_zh: 学校下个月将实施新的午餐规定。

imply.example_en: His faint smile seemed to imply that he agreed.
imply.example_zh: 他淡淡的微笑似乎在暗示他同意了。

impose.example_en: Do not impose extra chores on the youngest child.
impose.example_zh: 不要把额外的家务强加给家里最小的孩子。

impress.example_en: Her confident speech can impress the whole school.
impress.example_zh: 她自信的发言能给全校同学留下深刻印象。

include.example_en: The ticket price will include lunch and the bus fare.
include.example_zh: 票价里将包括午餐和车费。

incorporate.example_en: We incorporate family photos into the class yearbook.
incorporate.example_zh: 我们把家人的照片编进班级年鉴。

increase.example_en: Warm weather will increase the sales of cold drinks.
increase.example_zh: 天气变暖后，冷饮的销量会增加。

inform.example_en: Inform the nurse if you feel sick at school.
inform.example_zh: 在学校身体不舒服时，要告诉校医。

insist.example_en: Mum will insist on warm coats in this cold wind.
insist.example_zh: 风这么冷，妈妈一定会坚持让我们穿厚外套。

install.example_en: Dad will install a brighter lamp in my bedroom.
install.example_zh: 爸爸会在我的卧室里装一盏更亮的灯。

integrate.example_en: The coach will integrate new players into the team.
integrate.example_zh: 教练会让新队员融入这支球队。

intend.example_en: I intend to visit my grandparents this weekend.
intend.example_zh: 我打算这个周末去看望爷爷奶奶。

introduce.example_en: Let me introduce my cousin from Shanghai to you.
introduce.example_zh: 让我把从上海来的表姐介绍给你。

invest.example_en: My aunt will invest her savings in a small bookshop.
invest.example_zh: 我姑姑会把积蓄投资到一家小书店。

invite.example_en: We invite our neighbours to the New Year dinner.
invite.example_zh: 我们邀请邻居们来家里吃年夜饭。

join.example_en: Join the art club if you enjoy painting.
join.example_zh: 如果你喜欢画画，就加入美术社团吧。

judge.example_en: Three teachers will judge the English speech contest.
judge.example_zh: 三位老师将评判英语演讲比赛。

jump.example_en: The cat can jump from the chair onto the table.
jump.example_zh: 猫可以从椅子跳到桌子上。

justify.example_en: He tried to justify the broken window to his dad.
justify.example_zh: 他试图为打碎的窗户向爸爸辩解。

kick.example_en: Kick the football toward the goal rather than the seats.
kick.example_zh: 把足球踢向球门，别踢向座位。

kill.example_en: Late frost can kill young plants in the garden.
kill.example_zh: 晚霜会把花园里的幼苗冻死。

knock.example_en: Knock on the office door before you go inside.
knock.example_zh: 进办公室之前要先敲门。

know.example_en: I know a safe path to the nearest bus stop.
know.example_zh: 我知道一条通往最近公交站的安全小路。

laugh.example_en: We laugh at funny cartoons during the lunch break.
laugh.example_zh: 午休时我们看着搞笑卡通，忍不住大笑。

launch.example_en: The reading club will launch a book week in March.
launch.example_zh: 阅读社团将在三月发起读书周。

lay.example_en: Lay the map flat on the desk so everyone can see it.
lay.example_zh: 把地图平铺在书桌上，好让每个人都能看见。

lead.example_en: Our captain will lead the team onto the field.
lead.example_zh: 队长会带领球队走上球场。

learn.example_en: Children learn to ride bikes on the park path.
learn.example_zh: 孩子们在公园的小路上学骑自行车。

leave.example_en: We leave the classroom when the bell rings.
leave.example_zh: 铃声一响，我们就离开教室。

lend.example_en: Can you lend me a pencil for the history quiz?
lend.example_zh: 历史小测时，你能借我一支铅笔吗？

lick.example_en: The hungry dog will lick the empty rice bowl.
lick.example_zh: 那只饿狗会去舔空饭碗。

lie.example_en: Lie on the sofa for a while if you feel dizzy.
lie.example_zh: 如果觉得头晕，就在沙发上躺一会儿。

limit.example_en: Limit phone time so you can finish tonight's homework.
limit.example_zh: 限制玩手机的时间，这样才能做完今晚的作业。

listen.example_en: Listen carefully to the announcement in the hall.
listen.example_zh: 仔细听礼堂里的广播通知。

live.example_en: My cousins live in a flat near the city park.
live.example_zh: 我的表兄妹住在城市公园附近的一套公寓里。

load.example_en: Load the suitcases into the car before we leave.
load.example_zh: 出发前把行李箱装进汽车里。

lock.example_en: Lock your bicycle before you enter the bookshop.
lock.example_zh: 进书店之前，先把自行车锁好。

log.example_en: Students log their running times in a sports notebook.
log.example_zh: 学生们把每次跑步的时间记在运动笔记本上。

look.example_en: Look both ways before you step off the pavement.
look.example_zh: 走下人行道之前，先看左右两边。

lose.example_en: She may lose her student card on the crowded bus.
lose.example_zh: 她可能会在拥挤的公交车上弄丢学生卡。

love.example_en: I love spicy noodles on rainy Sunday evenings.
love.example_zh: 我喜欢在下雨的星期天晚上吃辣面条。

make.example_en: Grandma and I make dumplings every Spring Festival.
make.example_zh: 每年春节，我和奶奶一起包饺子。

manage.example_en: She can manage the weekend book sale by herself.
manage.example_zh: 周末的售书活动她一个人就能办好。

mark.example_en: Mark each wrong answer with a red pen.
mark.example_zh: 用红笔把每一道错题标出来。

marry.example_en: They will marry at the town hall next spring.
marry.example_zh: 他们明年春天将在市政厅结婚。

match.example_en: This blue tie does not match my white shirt.
match.example_zh: 这条蓝领带和我的白衬衫不相配。

mean.example_en: A red flag on the beach can mean danger.
mean.example_zh: 海滩上的红旗可能意味着有危险。

meet.example_en: We meet our teacher at the museum entrance.
meet.example_zh: 我们在博物馆入口遇见老师。
